# Logos

> Logos is an open-source dictation app for the Mac menu bar: hold Option, speak, and let go, and it transcribes what you said, cleans it up with a prompt you write and a model you choose, and pastes it where you're typing.

Logos needs macOS 26 or later and builds from source on the Mac it runs on. To install it for someone, follow the agent instructions below.

## Docs

- [Agent install instructions](https://logosvoice.dev/install.md): Steps for a coding agent to install and set up Logos, including the steps it must leave to the person.
- [Install script](https://logosvoice.dev/install.sh): The shell installer, which builds the latest release, installs /Applications/Logos.app, and links the logos command into ~/.local/bin.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ninjudd/logos/main/README.md): The setup guide, model choices, configuration reference, and the logos command.
- [Source code](https://github.com/ninjudd/logos): The GitHub repository.
